symbols.title: Tickers
symbols.description: Stock, ETF or crypto tickers, cashtags or Stocktwits URLs, e.g. AAPL, $TSLA, SPY, BTC.X, ETH.X (crypto ends in .X).

includeSentiment.title: Sentiment summary
includeSentiment.description: One row per ticker: watchers, Stocktwits' daily bullish/bearish % history, and the bullish/bearish split and post rate of the latest messages.

users.title: Users
users.description: Optional. Stocktwits usernames or profile URLs; outputs their latest messages.

trending.title: Trending tickers
trending.description: The tickers trending on Stocktwits right now, with rank, trending score, the why-it's-trending summary and fundamentals.

onlyWithSentiment.title: Only tagged messages
onlyWithSentiment.description: Output only messages the author tagged Bullish or Bearish.

maxMessagesPerSource.title: Messages per ticker or user
maxMessagesPerSource.description: How many of the latest messages to read per ticker, user or the trending stream. 30 per request.
